verdict.rationale: Drata's own public API v2 reference lists endpoints for each part of the story: creating custom frameworks and their requirements, creating controls and mapping them to requirements, creating custom monitoring tests, and creating evidence library items. Together these cover custom frameworks and controls with your own tests and evidence alongside the existing framework catalog. The evidence, however, is only endpoint titles, with no descriptive or hands-on detail. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how custom tests and evidence requirements attach to custom controls, any UI-based workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones
